capability: When two sources disagree, show both instead of picking
title: Show both sides of the edge.

hook.picture: Close: two lines (two sources) each carry a small date card toward the whale. The cards do not match. The whale quietly drops one into the sea and keeps the other.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Two websites gave me two dates, and I picked one.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: many pairs of source lines meet. Three times, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, the whale drops one card unseen; the sea under the line fills with dropped cards.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: We pick one and hide the other.

stakes.body: You act on the wrong answer and never learn that a second answer existed.

solution_hint: Keep both. Show where they disagree.

metaphor.body: Two sources are two lines that meet at a join. Instead of throwing one answer into the sea, both cards sit on the join with their labels, and the join glows if they differ.

steps.picture: The two source lines meet at a dashed join. The whale sets both date cards on it side by side instead of dropping one.
steps.words: Keep both. Show where they disagree.

steps.picture: The join reads both ends; they differ, so it glows copper. A small tag on each card names where it came from.
steps.words: Each answer keeps its own label.
steps.sound: The pair beats with the copper glow.

steps.picture: Push-in: a third line arrives, an official source. Its card matches one of the two; that join turns teal. The other stays copper, still on screen.
steps.words: A better source can settle it.
steps.sound: One pair resolves to unison; one still beats.

steps.picture: A label slides onto the joins where sources meet: seam. Copper and teal both stay visible.
steps.sound: Unison and beat side by side.

real_case.claim: Illustration only. manutej/glue could not be read (private or unavailable), so no real run or number is shown for this film.

source.title: No source: manutej/glue not readable from this session

honest_limit.picture: Push to a teal join: both sources agree on one date. A fourth card, the real timetable, floats in with a third date. The join stayed teal anyway.
honest_limit.words: Both sites agreed. Both were wrong.

not_this.body: Two sources agreeing can both be wrong.

ending_pattern.body: The two clashing cards both land on the join with their labels, nothing sinks, and the pod checks both before answering ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The card the whale threw into the sea in bar 1 now sits on the join beside its rival.

end_belief.body: When sources disagree, show both. Then check.
